_note: Paper-only (fake money) XRP strategy variants run side by side on the same live data. Stakes above $10 (cost + fee) are clipped in code. 'timeframe' picks the Polymarket XRP market family: 5m = xrp-updown-5m, 1h = xrp-updown-1h. 'sides' limits which side a variant may bet. 'min_lead_pct' = XRP must already be at least this % of price past the price-to-beat in our direction. Thresholds calibrated for XRP from 14 days of Coinbase 1m candles (see tweaks/).

control.desc: CONTROL (5m): plain pure-model bettor, both sides, no lead gate, no trend filters. $1 +$1 per extra 1c of edge, cap $5 incl. fee, any time from 30-240s left, asks 5-95c

model_lead.desc: MODEL + LEAD GATE (5m): model blended 50/50 with market, 4c edge, only 180-240s left (3-4 min), and XRP must already be 0.055% (~0.05c) past the price-to-beat our way. Cap $5 incl. fee ($2 above 70c)

ride_favorite_80.desc: RIDE THE FAVORITE 80c+ (5m): buy whichever side the market favors, only when it costs 80-95c, with 60-120s left. Flat $5 incl. fee, no model

trend_volume.desc: TREND + VOLUME (5m, both ways): bets WITH the last hour's trend when 60m and 15m momentum agree, lower/higher highs and lows, and volume backs the move. 50/50 model+market +3c trend bonus, 3c edge, 90-240s left, asks 30-75c, cap $5 incl. fee. (Best BTC variant, ported with XRP's higher-volatility limit)

trend_volume_xo.desc: CASH OUT (5m): same entry as trend_volume, but can sell early into the live best bid (only if that bid has enough size for the full position) and pays the taker fee on the sale. Take profit if the bid reaches 95c or the sale would make about +20% after the sell fee. Stop loss if the position is down about 45% (sale proceeds at most 55% of what we paid). Also sells if the price lead flips against us with a minute or less left (and we're in the back half of the window). Holds at least 20 seconds, and leaves the last 8 seconds for the official result. If none of those happen, holds to settlement like the original.

model_lead_xo.desc: CASH OUT (5m): same entry as model_lead, but can sell early into the live best bid (only if that bid has enough size for the full position) and pays the taker fee on the sale. Take profit if the bid reaches 95c or the sale would make about +20% after the sell fee. Stop loss if the position is down about 45% (sale proceeds at most 55% of what we paid). Also sells if the price lead flips against us with a minute or less left (and we're in the back half of the window). Holds at least 20 seconds, and leaves the last 8 seconds for the official result. If none of those happen, holds to settlement like the original.

ride_favorite_80_xo.desc: CASH OUT (5m): same entry as ride_favorite_80, but can sell early into the live best bid (only if that bid has enough size for the full position) and pays the taker fee on the sale. Take profit if the bid reaches 95c or the sale would make about +10% after the sell fee. Stop loss if the position is down about 45% (sale proceeds at most 55% of what we paid). Also sells if the price lead flips against us with a minute or less left (and we're in the back half of the window). Holds at least 20 seconds, and leaves the last 8 seconds for the official result. If none of those happen, holds to settlement like the original.

trend_volume_15m.desc: 15-MINUTE: same idea as trend_volume, but on the 15-minute Up/Down market. Timing gates are scaled ×3 to fit the longer window (first 3 minutes are skipped, like the first minute on 5m). Holds to the official result (no early cash-out on this variant).

model_lead_15m.desc: 15-MINUTE: same idea as model_lead, but on the 15-minute Up/Down market. Timing gates are scaled ×3 to fit the longer window (first 3 minutes are skipped, like the first minute on 5m). Holds to the official result (no early cash-out on this variant).

trend_down.desc: TREND RIDER, DOWN ONLY (5m): same idea as trend_volume but only bets Down, when the last hour is trending down (lower highs and lows) with 60m/15m momentum agreeing and volume at least equal on the down candles. 90-240s left, asks 25-80c, cap $5 incl. fee

breakdown.desc: BREAKDOWN, DOWN ONLY (5m): a finished 1-min candle closed below the prior 30-min low on 2x+ average volume and price is still below it. Bets Down. 3c edge, 90-240s left, asks 25-80c, $2 +$1 per 2c extra edge, cap $5 incl. fee ($3 above 70c)

down_ride.desc: DOWN RIDE (5m): bets Down only when XRP is ALREADY at least 0.055% (~0.05c) below the price-to-beat with 90-180s left (2-3.5 min into the window), a 'lead already built by 2-3 minutes in' setup.  Model+market blend, 3c edge after the ask and fee, asks 50-90c, flat-ish $2 +$1 per 2c extra edge, cap $5 incl. fee. Does NOT bet just because the last window was down.

hourly_ride_down.desc: HOURLY RIDE DOWN (1h market): bets Down mid-hour only if XRP is ALREADY at least 0.1% below the hour's price-to-beat with 30-45 min left (15-30 min in), and the broader 4-hour trend is net down (used only as a filter). Model+market blend, 3c edge after ask and fee, asks 40-85c, $2 +$1 per 2c extra edge, cap $5 incl. fee. Hourly spreads are 3-6c, so it fills at the ask.

crowd.desc: CROWD (5m): bets with whatever side is most popular. Reads the official public comment feed for this event (keyword lean: up/pump/moon/long vs down/dump/short/rekt) and, because these short markets often have no chat, falls back to public trade-flow (buy volume on Up vs Down) plus a book-imbalance check. Bets only when the signal is clear, with 60-180s left, asks 25-90c, about $4 incl. fee (5-share min, $10 cap). Not used by auto_pick or bankroll_20.

max_profit.desc: MAX PROFIT (5m+15m, fake $100 account): tries to grow a $100 fake-money bankroll as fast as it can. Uses the best available signals from the other variants (and crowd when chat/flow is clear), both sides, and can sell early (cash-out). Sizes with half-Kelly, capped at 25% of current equity and never so large that a loss would break a $12 floor (pauses if cash falls below $12). Because this is fake money it may exceed the usual $10-per-bet cap — do not use this with real money as-is. May rest a paper limit at the bid when the spread is wide. Not used by auto_pick or bankroll_20.

auto_pick.desc: AUTO PICK (5m): every round it ranks the other 5m variants by net fake P&L on bets settled in the last 6 hours (falls back to since-start if nobody qualifies in the window). A variant qualifies with 5+ settled bets and positive P&L. It follows ONLY its current pick's bets (same side, same moment); if the pick doesn't bet in a window it sits out. New leader must be best at 2 straight checks. Flat $3 target incl. fee (rounded up to the 5-share minimum, never above $5 total; hard max $10). Own separate fake account.

bankroll_20.desc: BANKROLL $20→$1,000 (5m, fake money only): starts with a $20 fake-money balance and tries to grow it to $1,000. Follows ONLY the group's current auto_pick (other 5m variants ranked by 6-hour net fake P&L; 5+ settled bets and positive P&L to qualify; new leader must be best at 2 straight checks). Bets about 20% of its cash each time, rounded up to the 5-share minimum, never more than $10 including the taker fee, never more than the cash on hand. Stops if the balance can't cover a minimum order (busted) or once the $1,000 goal is hit. Own separate fake account; does not change the other variants.

ab_hedge_5m.desc: A/B HEDGE (5m): an A bot and a B bot on opposite sides, trying to pull a win off a loss. A buys early-ish (about 60-120s into the 5-minute window, after the first-minute skip) on whichever side the coin's price already leads, about $5 including the fee (5-share minimum, $10 cap). B watches the other side for the rest of the window and only buys the same number of shares if A's cost + B's ask + both taker fees is at least 2 cents under $1/share, which locks a small guaranteed profit at settlement. If that cheap hedge never appears, B may still buy in the back half when A is badly losing (price lead flipped and A is down about 40%) to cap the locked loss at about 10 cents/share (logged as limit_loss, not lock_profit). If neither happens, A just rides to the official result alone. Uses real book depth (skips if the best ask is too small). Fake money only. Not used by auto_pick or bankroll_20.

ab_hedge_15m.desc: A/B HEDGE (15m): same A-then-B hedge as ab_hedge_5m, on the 15-minute Up/Down market. A enters early-ish (about 3-6 minutes into the window, after the 3-minute skip), about $5 including the fee. B only buys the other side if it locks at least 2 cents/share of guaranteed profit, or later as a damage-limit cap when A is badly losing. Otherwise A holds to settlement alone. Fake money only. Not used by auto_pick or bankroll_20.

ab_hedge_1h.desc: A/B HEDGE (1h): same A-then-B hedge as ab_hedge_5m, on the hourly Up/Down market (this is the timeframe most likely to give B a cheap opposite-side ask). A enters early-ish (about 12-24 minutes into the hour), about $5 including the fee. B only buys the other side if it locks at least 2 cents/share of guaranteed profit, or later as a damage-limit cap when A is badly losing. Otherwise A holds to settlement alone. Fake money only. Not used by auto_pick or bankroll_20.
